text: Nina Zaech: Victoria Marine Lake predates the listed Havre des Pas pool by eight years, yet it remains unlisted and at risk," she said.
An aerial shot of the Victoria Marine Lake in St Helier. A sandy beach is behind a water-filled the pool, with St Helier behind that.
A petition has been launched to restore and maintain a historic marine lake which is facing an uncertain future.
